data.title: bn-3rp0: Add audit-logged review retargeting for Git
data.description: Adds an append-only ReviewRetargeted event and author-only CLI command. Retargeting preserves the review base, reopens approval, clears effective votes, and records old and new anchors plus commits. Includes detached-Git, projection rebuild, error-path, and full-gate coverage.

data.reason: Security review passed. Author-only + same-backend gates enforced; all git calls argv-based with validate_anchor and --end-of-options (no injection); anchors resolve before any append (no partial writes); is_ancestor gate confines retarget to review history; retarget clears votes and reopens approval (safe direction, no block bypass); dedup key includes ts+discriminant so retarget events don't collide; parameterized SQL.
